KI JINGKYNTHOH (a) ICatto kotne ki^ntien shaphang kane ka Kot, Ki jingmih pyrthei jong ki kot Khasi mynta ki por ka stad shibun, hynrei, palat ia ka jingsted, ka don ruh ka kyrdan jong ki jingthoh. Ha ka Hang ka prose, fiction bad kiwei kjwei ki jingthoh ki bym dei ki poetry ki nongtboh Khasi ki la nang pyn- mih ki jingthoh kiba kordor shibun bad kiba khraw ruh ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat, Ha ka liang ka poetry ki Khasi ki la jam stiakhmat bha bad don ki nongthoh poetry kiba iada la lah ban pynkylia ia ki poetry jong ki sha ka ktien phareng bad ha kiwei pat ki Jaidbyariew kin loh pule, kine ki nongthoh kin paw sha ka pyrthei ym tang ha Ri Khasi hyniei sha India bad sha ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei Kin long internationally known. Dei namar ba ka nongrim ia ka thoh ka tar u Khasi ka la par ha ki thied snam jong u ha ki poetry arlaifi ki Phawar, bad na kane ka nongrim ka poetry Khasi ka iaid shaphrang bha. Ka jing* thoh ha ki prose, fiction bad novel ka ia sdang mynta ban bud bad iaid shaphrang bad ban ia kynjoh bad ka kyrdan kaba ka poetry ka don. La nud ban ong mynta ba kine ki lukom thoh prose etc. ki la poi ha kata ka kyrdan. Dang shisnem sbiteng mynta i Bah Kitbor Nongrum i la ai sha ngi ia ka Kot Ka Pung Ka Jingieit kaba pyni ia ka bor mutdur jong i kum u nongthoh shaphang ka jingieit ba ka trei ha ki dohnud samla ha ki rukom bapher bapher. Ha kane kaba i pynmib biang mynta kaba i ai kyrteng : U Shanbor bad U Wadbor i wanrah biang ia ka jingieit ha kawei

pat ka dur. Ka jingiaieit u Shanbor ka long kaba iaid beit bad sngewtynnad haduh bakut. Ka long kaba ym don jingwoh jingthaiB bad kaba da donburom. Ka jingiaieit u Wadbor ka da don ki maw jynthut kiba pynwit bad pynsmiej ia ngi ki nongpule bad ngi ia sngewlemiau: tipkanjia aiu ? Hynrei hadien ki jingthut bad jingwit kiba ieng hapdeng u Wadbor bad i samla jong u i Wanpli kajingkut ka long kaba sngewtynnad, la kumba ong u Sbakespear ‘'All’s well that ends well” lane kumba pynkut i Bah Frank M. Pugh ha kawei na ki poem jing- ieit kiba i la thoh bad i ong kumne ^‘lajngoh baroh, jingiathoh yn rai, laroh, iaroht iai iaroh khicmwai ; Khoh ia sniehdoh, diengshailidoh to shoh, Tmoh buh ha khoh, iabam doh baroh ” I Bah Kitbor i long u romantic writer uba pynshong nong- rim ia ki jingthoh jong i ha ka dur Khasi ka Khasi scene. U pyndonkam ruh da ki ktien kum ka ‘jingiapoikha’ haba bun mynta ngi ia ong ^shongkurim.’ Ki rangbah Khasi kiju kien shibun shaphang kane ka ktien *poikha.* Kawei pat kaba i pyndonkam ka long ka ktien *Ksiang’. Baroh kine ki long Khasi nylla. Nalor ka bor pyrkhat, ka jinglah ban mutdur bad ka jing* peitthuh ia kiba don ha ka Ri, ha ki samla, ha ki ling ki sem ha sor bad nongkyndong, bad, ba i pynwan ia ka ha ki jingia- thuhkhana kiba sngewtynnad, i Bah Kitbor i don ruh ka biria- ka humour kaba pynbang la ki nongpule. Ka jingthoh ia u Bah Teilaijg ba u phoi ka ktik ia ki nongpule. Ka jingthoh shaphang ka trei smat trei sting u Wad bor haba u iohsngew ba u Shanbor u don jingmut shawei pnt bad ba ym dei ia kaba u Wadbor u la lab iaieit lupa, kata ruh ka pynsammut ia ki nongpule. Ngi ai khublei ia i Bah Kitbor na ka bynta kane ka kot bad ngi kyrmen skhem ba in dang iai sei sbuh ia ki jingthoh ba sngewtynnad jong i kiba tei ia ki ^aiala nongpule. Dated
